collaboration.intro: Give the team a task. They read the project and wait for you before each step.

collaboration.writerSummary: Reads the files it needs, changes them after you approve, and can run the allowed tests. It cannot delete files. When work is sent back, it fixes only the listed items.
collaboration.reviewerSummary: Reads the real files, runs the allowed tests, and names each real bug with an input that shows it. If it finds a real bug, it sends the work back to Writer with a list of fixes. Otherwise it gives a clear verdict. It cannot change files.

dataStatement.title: Before you connect
dataStatement.sentToProvider: Mail and calendar text that an agent reads is sent to the AI model provider, so it leaves this platform.
dataStatement.mailAndCalendarRead: For unread mail, the sender, subject, date and a short excerpt of the message body are read. Mail is not marked as read. Calendar event titles and times are read.
dataStatement.noChanges: Nothing is sent, deleted or changed in your mailbox or calendar.
dataStatement.stored: Saved run results can include the text that was read. Your app password and calendar link are stored encrypted and never shown again.

gmail.one: Turn on 2-Step Verification for your Google Account (Google Account, then Security).
gmail.two: Create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Any name works.
gmail.three: Paste the 16-letter app password below with your Gmail address.

yahoo.one: Turn on 2-step verification for your Yahoo account (Account info, then Account security).
yahoo.two: In Account security, choose Generate app password and create one.
yahoo.three: Paste the app password below with your Yahoo Mail address.

icloud.one: Turn on two-factor authentication for your Apple Account.
icloud.two: At account.apple.com, open Sign-In and Security, then App-Specific Passwords, and create one.
icloud.three: Paste the app-specific password below with your iCloud Mail address.

mail.title: Mail
mail.intro: Agents can read the sender, subject, date and a short excerpt of each unread message. They do not mark mail as read, and they cannot send, reply or change anything.
mail.noteAppPassword: Use an app password, not your normal password. You can delete it at your provider at any time.
mail.noteAdvancedProtection: Google accounts with Advanced Protection, and some company or school Google accounts, block app passwords and cannot connect this way.
mail.noteOutlook: Outlook.com and Hotmail are not supported yet.
mail.appPasswordHint: It is cleared from this form when you press Connect and never shown again.
mail.disconnectBody: The saved app password is deleted from this platform. Your mailbox is not changed. You can connect again at any time.
mail.disconnected: Mail disconnected. The saved app password was deleted.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: Agents can read today's events from a private calendar link. They cannot accept invites or change events.
calendar.stepOne: Open Google Calendar on a computer and go to Settings.
calendar.stepTwo: Under Settings for my calendars, pick your calendar, then open Integrate calendar.
calendar.stepThree: Copy Secret address in iCal format (it starts with https://) and paste it below.
calendar.noteSecret: Anyone with this link can read your calendar. Keep it private; you can reset it in Google Calendar settings.
calendar.noteAdmin: On a company or school account, an admin can turn this link off. If you cannot find it, that is likely why.
calendar.noteOther: Another calendar app works too if it gives you a private https iCal link.
calendar.linkHint: It is cleared from this form when you press Connect and never shown again.
calendar.disconnectBody: The saved calendar link is deleted from this platform. Your calendar is not changed. You can connect again at any time.
calendar.disconnected: Calendar disconnected. The saved calendar link was deleted.
